after.scorer_change: 615a585634 also made the scorer read a gap's "concerns": null as no concerns. It was first kept at plx-eval-scorer/12 (the dev fixture baseline is unchanged); since the same answer can score differently, the version moved; main took plx-eval-scorer/13 for the one prose screen in the meantime, so after the rebase on main the rule is plx-eval-scorer/14. The a-h and a-i runs below were scored by that rule under the /12 label, without the /13 prose screen; the post-rebase run is scored by /14. Re-checked on the transcripts: no answer in the a-h or a-i run has a null concerns, so no outcome in those runs depends on it; in the a-g run it made one answer (dev-F1-0001-fixture) answer_malformed:gaps instead of scored, and that item fails on gap_missing either way. The 2 to 4 step is the agent's answers, not the scorer.

classes.tool_returned_nothing_useful: the tools served the question but not the fact the label needs (after: a same-number record under another vendor is never reported; a count of 0 is never returned, only a gap, since a count is 0 only on a proven-complete search, which no plan has yet).
classes.answer_cut: the answer stopped short of a value the evidence it read supports.
classes.lead_only_evidence: the deciding link is lead tier only, so the product leaves the decision unknown by the evidence rule; the label decides it.
classes.answer_prose_uncovered: every value passed, but the answer text stated a number (identifier digits under an unknown prefix, a count in words) no value claim stated: the close-outcome check (claim_unstructured) refuses it. The gate is right; the agent had no way to see it before the scorer.
classes.data_truly_absent: the fixture world the real agent's host serves holds no Business Central records (the baseline host serves the BC capture), so the BC purchase/sales invoice the question asks about is not ingested and the plan answers partial or not_found.
classes.scorer_mismatch: the answer's value is right but cited on another source row than the label (FileMaker vs Portal app for the same quantity).
